title: Fashion Consultant
description:
Job Title: Fashion Consultant

Company: Koterie by House of Kanchana — Premium Indian Womenswear, One\-Stop Bridal \& Occasionwear Destination

Location: 6, Rawdon St, Mullick Bazar, Park Street area, Kolkata, West Bengal 700017

Department: Retail Sales

Reports To: Floor Manager

Experience Required: 3\+ years

Employment Type: Full\-Time, includes holidays as per store roster

Role Summary

The Sales Executive is the face of the store's premium customer experience, guiding clients through bridal, festive and occasionwear collections (lehengas, sarees, indo\-western), building lasting client relationships, and converting footfall into sales. Senior Sales Executives (3\+ years in premium/luxury fashion retail) will also mentor juniors and handle high\-value/VIP clients.

Key Responsibilities

* Client Engagement — Greet and consult every walk\-in client on occasion, budget and styling needs.
* Product Advisory — Recommend fabric, drape, styling and accessory pairings suited to body type, occasion and budget.
* Individual Sales — Convert enquiries into sales; achieve monthly targets in peak and off\-season.
* Team Sales — Contribute to floor targets; support colleagues during high footfall and trunk shows.
* Upselling \& Cross\-selling — Increase units per transaction and average bill value.
* CRM \& Clienteling — Capture client details, preferences and occasion dates for follow\-up.
* Fitting \& Alterations Coordination — Manage trial, alteration and delivery timelines with the tailoring team.
* Billing \& Transactions — Process billing, returns and exchanges on POS as per SOP.
* Store \& VM Upkeep — Maintain visual merchandising, folding, tagging and rack standards.
* After\-Sales Service — Follow up post\-purchase and convert one\-time buyers into repeat clients.
* Mentorship (Senior only) — Coach juniors and own key/VIP bridal clients.

KPIs (monthly targets vary between wedding season Aug–Jan and off\-season)

* Individual sales target achievement %
* Team/floor target contribution %
* Conversion rate
* Average transaction value (ATV)
* Units per transaction (UPT)
* CRM data capture %
* Repeat client rate
* Customer complaints per month
* Grooming, attendance and SOP audit score

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* How familiar are you with:

1\. Fabrics  
2\. Embroidery and materials  
3\. Measurements  
4\. Draping  
5\. Silhouettes  
Please give a short answer for each point.

* Have you worked at a luxury Indian ethnic wear brand before? If yes, name the brand(s).
* If necessary due to high footfall, will you be able to work beyond 8pm in the initial months?

Experience:

* Retail sales in Luxury Indian Ethnic wear: 3 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: Global Salesforce Process Owner - Salesforce COE
description:
Date: Sep 23, 2026
Location:
IVGSSPL Kolkata, IN
Req ID: 1771
Company: Indorama Ventures GSSPL
Description:
**Our organization**:
Indorama Ventures is a global sustainable chemical company operating across multiple verticals such as Combined PET, Fibers, and Integrated Oxides \& Derivatives. The Global Capability Centre (GCC) in Kolkata, India supports worldwide operations through centralized IT, Finance and Business process services.


**Position Overview**


We are seeking a senior, business\-oriented Salesforce professional to own the end\-to\-end functional process design for our Salesforce process


Acting as the functional process owner, you will lead discovery and design decisions, establish common process standards, resolve cross\-functional requirements, and maintain traceability from business need through solution delivery and measurable outcomes.


This high\-impact role is accountable for the functional integrity of the process landscape, the quality and readiness of business requirements, business acceptance of delivered capabilities, process adoption, and continuous improvement. Delivery teams will own technical design and execution; this role will own the business process intent, functional outcomes, and design decisions.

  

**What You'll Do**
**Key Responsibilities**


**Functional Process Ownership \& Design**


* Own the end\-to\-end functional process design for Salesforce\-enabled commercial capabilities, from lead and opportunity management through quoting, contracting, order hand\-off, and customer lifecycle management.
* Define and maintain global process principles, target\-state process models, decision rights, business rules, controls, roles, personas, and hand\-offs across functions and regions.
* Lead structured discovery and design workshops, challenge local requirements, resolve process conflicts, and secure accountable business sign\-off on functional designs.
* Assess process gaps and improvement opportunities using business outcomes, data, risk, control, customer experience, and adoption considerations.
* Maintain clear traceability from strategic objective and business need through process design, requirement, delivered capability, control, and measurable benefit.

**Functional Design Authority \& Governance**


* Act as the functional design authority for Salesforce Sales Cloud and related commercial capabilities, ensuring designs align with enterprise process principles, platform guardrails, and the target operating model.
* Set the functional direction and approve key process decisions while partnering with architects and delivery teams on solution options, feasibility, integrations, data implications, and non\-functional constraints.
* Prevent unnecessary customization and process fragmentation by promoting standard capabilities, reusable patterns, and disciplined exception governance.
* Define functional acceptance criteria, oversee business validation and UAT readiness, and provide final functional acceptance for releases.
* Ensure process controls, data ownership, compliance requirements, and auditability are embedded in functional designs.

**Demand Prioritization \& Delivery Partnership**


* Shape and prioritize the functional demand pipeline with Business Product Owners and the Salesforce Platform Owner based on strategic alignment, business value, risk, dependency, and process maturity.
* Own the quality and readiness of epics, process requirements, user stories, business rules, and acceptance criteria before work enters delivery.
* Provide timely functional decisions, clarify intent during delivery, manage scope trade\-offs, and ensure delivered capabilities remain aligned with approved process designs.
* Partner with release, testing, data, integration, and change teams to confirm business readiness, adoption plans, process controls, and benefit measures.

**Process Architecture, Documentation \& Adoption**


* Create and maintain authoritative process architecture and functional documentation, including current\- and target\-state maps, capability models, business rules, controls, role and persona maps, decision logs, and functional specifications.
* Communicate process direction, design decisions, impacts, and trade\-offs clearly to senior leaders, process owners, regional stakeholders, and delivery teams.
* Partner with change and learning teams to define role impacts, operating procedures, training needs, adoption measures, and post\-release reinforcement.
* Monitor process performance, user feedback, data quality, control effectiveness, and realized benefits to drive a prioritized continuous\-improvement roadmap.
  

**What We're Looking For**
**Educational Qualifications**


**Education \& Certifications**


* Bachelor’s degree in business, Engineering, Information Systems, Supply Chain, or a related discipline; an advanced degree is an advantage.
* Salesforce Administrator or Sales Cloud Consultant certification is preferred and should be supported by strong practical understanding of platform capabilities and constraints.
* Process\-management, business\-analysis, Lean Six Sigma, or agile product certification is an advantage.

**Nice to Have**


* Salesforce Certified CPQ Specialist certification.
* Experience with Salesforce Experience Cloud or Service Cloud.

**Experience**


**Core Skills \& Experience**


* 8\+ years of experience in business process ownership, process design, product management, or senior business analysis, including substantial responsibility for Salesforce\-enabled commercial processes.
* Demonstrated ownership of complex end\-to\-end functional process design across multiple functions, regions, or business units, with authority to drive standardization and resolve competing requirements.
* Strong knowledge of Sales Cloud and the sales lifecycle, including lead, account, opportunity, pipeline, customer, forecasting, and quote\-to\-order processes; Salesforce CPQ experience is advantageous.
* Experience in a manufacturing or complex commercial environment, with a practical understanding of global process variation, controls, customer experience, data ownership, and integration hand\-offs.
* Proven ability to translate strategy and business outcomes into target\-state processes, policies, business rules, functional requirements, decision frameworks, and measurable success criteria.
* Strong facilitation, negotiation, and decision\-making skills, including the confidence to challenge stakeholders, manage exceptions, and obtain senior\-level alignment.
* Experience governing demand and backlogs, assuring requirement quality, supporting UAT and release readiness, and measuring adoption and business benefits in an agile delivery environment.
* Excellent analytical, process\-modelling, documentation, and executive communication skills; proficiency with tools such as Visio, Lucidchart, Signavio, Jira, Confluence, or Azure DevOps.
* Sufficient technical fluency to evaluate Salesforce solution options and data or integration implications while maintaining clear accountability boundaries with architects and delivery teams.

**Behavioral Skills**


**Leadership \& Behavioral Skills**


* Enterprise mindset with clear personal accountability for process outcomes, standards, controls, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Able to lead through influence across business functions, regions, and technical teams, including in situations where priorities or local practices conflict.
* Decisive and pragmatic, balancing global standardization, business value, customer experience, risk, delivery feasibility, and time to value.
* Exceptional workshop facilitation, stakeholder management, structured problem\-solving, and executive communication skills.
* Collaborative and outcome\-focused, working effectively with Business Product Owners, process owners, the Salesforce COE, architects, delivery teams, data teams, and change leaders.
